system.description:
[Trigger: Action & Fate 1] Used at the same time as "Beat Up". Adds +["Wyvern Kick" SR × 6] to the direct damage dealt by the effect of "Beat Up". A metallic additional armor that envelops both hands and feet, glowing with a silver sheen. It is believed to be a special golem equipment from the Alvean era, though details are unknown. It has a function that allows for sudden bursts of initiative by utilizing excess MP released into the atmosphere.

Spirit Mirror of the Autumn Rain [Core Material] (560G) + Katar (1000G) + Leggings (730G) + [Magic Catalyst 18] (310G) ×4 + Crafting Cost (1390G)
